sponsored.t: Enacts the drug and special watch due process act
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards and procedures governing drug and special watches and temporary isolation based upon suspected ingestion or internal concealment of contraband.

sponsored.t: Relates to human-led instruction and artificial intelligence in schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits humanoid robots and AI systems from being used in schools; provides limited exceptions; provides for student privacy protections; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Restricts certain correctional security employees from high-risk assignments following disciplinary action or during a disciplinary evaluation period
sponsored.sum: Restricts certain correctional security employees from high-risk assignments following disciplinary action or during a disciplinary evaluation period; provides for restoration of eligibility following completion of a disciplinary evaluation period or other period of assignment restriction; directs the department to notify restricted employees; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a rare kidney disease screening pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a rare kidney disease screening pilot program within the department of health to operate in at least two counties or regions in the state, targeting at-risk populations, to improve early diagnosis of RKD, connect patients with treatments and care, and evaluate the effectiveness and scalability of state-based RKD screening initiatives.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state credit risk transparency and investor protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state credit risk transparency and investor protection act" requiring issuers of state-backed bonds to issue quarterly risk statements.

sponsored.t: Allows individuals to register in the donate life registry through personal income tax filings
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of taxation and finance to include an opportunity on certain personal income tax forms for individuals to provide written consent to be added to the donate life registry; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive
sponsored.sum: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive provided such member is a state-paid judge or justice of the unified court system or a housing judge of the civil court of the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to collection of social security account numbers for registration with the New York state donate life registry
sponsored.sum: Authorizes insurers to collect social security account numbers solely for the purpose of effectuating, verifying, or amending an individual's donor registration status in the New York state donate life registry; prohibits use of such information other than for such purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of tenant screening criteria
sponsored.sum: Provides that a landlord shall provide a prospective tenant a written disclosure of the tenant screening criteria used to evaluate rental applications prior to accepting any fee, deposit, or screening information from such prospective tenant.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the compensation of Catholic Guardian Services for fair and equitable holding expenses associated with lands transferred to Catholic Home Bureau
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the compensation to Catholic Guardian Services for fair and equitable holding expenses associated with lands transferred to Catholic Home Bureau which reverted to the state upon termination of their use for public purposes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the mental health integration for networked data (MIND) act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a centralized mental health data reporting and integration platform to be utilized by all state-operated and county-administered mental health programs, as well as all providers licensed or funded by the office of mental health for the provision of mental health services.

sponsored.t: Provides a host community benefit for customers in a host community where data centers are expanded or placed
sponsored.sum: Requires hyperscale data centers to offset their electricity demand by funding household electrification measures.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to statewide teacher support and retention programs
sponsored.sum: Provides for automatic eligibility to teacher support and retention programs for teachers employed by certain schools receiving funding for the provision of special education.

sponsored.t: Increases access to substance abuse programming for incarcerated individuals whose first language is not English
sponsored.sum: Increases access to substance abuse programming for incarcerated individuals whose first language is not English.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a bank relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition of fees or surcharges for any service rendered through a banking organization relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires sexual and domestic violence awareness posters in certain businesses
sponsored.sum: Requires sexual and domestic violence awareness posters in cosmetology establishments.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to discipline certain employees for acts of serious misconduct
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to discipline certain employees for acts of serious misconduct; defines serious misconduct; establishes procedures for such disciplinary action; prohibits employees who have been removed for serious misconduct from being placed on the eligible list after such removal.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "extreme weather tenant protection act"
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for a moratorium on evictions during extreme weather conditions, and the 72-hour period following such conditions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the justice center for the protection of people with special needs
sponsored.sum: Provides that members of the surrogate decision-making committee for medical care and treatment shall be appointed by the justice center for the protection of people with special needs; reassigns certain functions of the commission on quality of care for the mentally disabled to the justice center.

sponsored.t: Requires at least one electric level three fast charging station for every five thousand New York state residents
sponsored.sum: Requires at least one electric level three fast charging station available to the public for every five thousand New York state residents on a county level by December 31, 2027; provides for the siting of such charging stations; requires construction and development of such stations to comply with article 8 of the labor law including payment of the prevailing wage.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale, offer for sale, or delivery of xylazine
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the knowing sale, offer for sale, or delivery of xylazine to persons under the age of 21 and without proof of the intended use for institutional, veterinary, or scientific purposes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of credit history in the tenant screening process for applicants who are survivors of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Provides that a landlord shall not request, obtain, or consider a consumer credit report or credit history for a prospective tenant who provides a written self-attestation that they are a victim of domestic violence, and shall not deny an application for rental housing on the basis of credit history when the applicant is a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Specifies that certain teachers, teacher aides, and teacher assistants shall be included in the excessive teacher turnover prevention program
sponsored.sum: Specifies that teachers, teacher aides, and teacher assistants that work with children with a disability, and who are employed by schools commonly referred to as 4410 schools and 853 schools, shall be included in the excessive teacher turnover prevention program.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the operation of uncrewed aircraft, including drones, over school grounds or critical infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of uncrewed aircraft, including drones, over school grounds or critical infrastructure; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to housing stability protections for at-risk tenants
sponsored.sum: Allows certain tenants to submit emergency housing transfer requests to the appropriate public housing agency; provides for support for survivors of domestic violence; provides for the creation of a centralized emergency housing transfer platform; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the family protection act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting family relationships to ensure that family ties are not severed unnecessarily or counter to children's best interests.

sponsored.t: Relates to special education labor market fairness
sponsored.sum: Authorizes education-related dual employment for employees of certain schools offering special education services; prohibits certain anti-competitive actions that would impact such schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to limited-scope radiographers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a holder of a license to perform limited-scope radiography to practice radiography at urgent care centers under the supervision of a licensed practitioner or licensed registered radiologic technologist; defines limited-scope radiographer as a person licensed to practice radiography limited to chest, extremities, skull/sinus, and spine/sacrum at urgent care centers; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an e-bike safety program to provide new e-bikes to certain delivery service workers at reduced or no cost in exchange for used unsafe e-bikes
sponsored.sum: Provides that NYSERDA shall establish a program to provide new e-bikes at reduced or no cost in exchange for used unsafe e-bikes to certain delivery service workers; provides eligibility requirements to receive a reduced or no-cost e-bike under such program; requires e-bikes provided pursuant to such program be certified for compliance with certain safety standards; requires NYSERDA to collaborate with relevant agencies to inform eligible individuals about such program; and requires NYSERDA to submit an annual report on such program.

sponsored.t: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes the building and fire code adherence tax credit which provides a tax credit to property owners who spend money to update a property to adhere to current applicable building and fire codes.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private right of action for tenants alleging a failure to keep and maintain self-closing doors
sponsored.sum: Establishes a private right of action for tenants alleging a failure to keep and maintain self-closing doors; allows for a court to award compensatory damages, reasonable attorney's fees and court costs and issue an order to the owner of the building to remedy any issue with such doors.

sponsored.t: Authorizes boards of cooperative educational services to enroll students in career and technical education courses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes boards of cooperative educational services to enroll students in career and technical education courses.

sponsored.t: Requires eligible agencies that receive state funding for universal prekindergarten located in N.Y. city to accept administration for children's services child care vouchers
sponsored.sum: Requires eligible agencies that receive state funding for universal prekindergarten located in a city with a population of one million or more to accept administration for children's services child care vouchers if such eligible agency is a licensed or registered child care setting.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the re-inspection of dwellings with mold violations
sponsored.sum: Requires the re-inspection of dwellings with mold violations.

sponsored.t: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment
sponsored.sum: Provides for a disability benefit for employees of the New York city transit authority, and its subsidiary corporations, who are disabled by reason of an assault sustained in the course of employment.

sponsored.t: Enacts the limited-scope wound care specialist certification act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "limited-scope wound care specialist certification act", directing the department of education to establish a program for the education and certification of individuals working for non-profit organizations as limited-scope wound care specialists.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal liability of corporations whose negligence, recklessness, or intentional or knowing acts cause the death or physical injury of a person on an unmarked worksite
sponsored.sum: Relates to criminal liability of corporations whose negligence, recklessness, or intentional or knowing acts cause the death or physical injury of a person on an unmarked worksite; defines term; authorizes court-ordered restitution in excess of certain statutory amounts; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the enhanced empire state child credit for infants act
sponsored.sum: Expands the empire state child tax credit by doubling the amount of such credit allowable for qualifying children under one year of age.

sponsored.t: Requires rent reduction in cases of submetered utility service
sponsored.sum: Requires rent reduction in cases of submetered utility service; directs the division of housing and community renewal to develop a standard reduction and an appeals process.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York student loan assistance and home purchase act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York student loan assistance and home purchase act", for the purposes of facilitating the purchase of homes by individuals who are burdened by student debt, by providing financing opportunities for the consolidation of student debt into a mortgage.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to return security deposits within a reasonable time
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to return the full security deposit and any accrued interest to which the tenant is entitled less any amount retained by the landlord within 21 days of the end of the lease.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulation of PFAS as a toxic air pollutant
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulation of PFAS as a toxic air pollutant; requires the department to ensure certain process operations use appropriate control technology for PFAS emissions; establishes a fence line monitoring program to monitor PFAS emissions in disadvantaged communities, to provide public reports, and related duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the environmentally conscious purchasing act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "environmentally conscious purchasing act"; prohibits state agencies and political subdivisions from purchasing single-use plastic products; defines terms; provides exceptions for medical reasons and garbage collection.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 of a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the sale of the first $35,000 for a battery, electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle from state sales and compensating use taxes; authorizes local governments to elect such incentives; repeals the hybrid exemption after ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of mental health clubhouses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of mental health clubhouses pursuant to a statewide implementation plan developed by the office of mental health.

sponsored.t: Prohibits elementary and secondary schools from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition
sponsored.sum: Prohibits elementary schools and secondary schools from withholding student transcripts for failure to pay tuition.

sponsored.t: Relates to a parent's right to know if an employee, volunteer or an administrator of a school district is reprimanded for inappropriate conduct towards their child
sponsored.sum: Relates to a parent's right to know if an employee, volunteer or an administrator of a school district is reprimanded for inappropriate conduct towards their child; enacts "parent's right to know" act.

sponsored.t: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent
sponsored.sum: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent and for modification of such orders.

sponsored.t: Establishes the addiction prevention and recovery act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the addiction prevention and recovery act; increases taxes on alcohol by fifty percent; allocates the increased revenue to a special fund to be used for the purposes of alcohol and substance abuse addiction prevention and recovery services and programs.

sponsored.t: Establishes a wound care kit and xylazine test strip distribution
sponsored.sum: Establishes a wound care kit and xylazine test strip distribution program to supply wound care kits designed for the treatment of injection-related wounds and skin and soft tissue infections, and xylazine test strips, to individuals with a substance use disorder or who are otherwise at risk of drug use, free of charge; prohibits facilities from collecting personally identifying information on such individuals; prohibits police from targeting individuals receiving wound care kits or xylazine test strips under such program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the mental health shelter placement accuracy and support act
sponsored.sum: Authorizes information in OMH's PSYCKES database and similar mental health databases to be disclosed to certain personnel engaged in shelter placement and support services; directs OTDA to establish certain protocols and to facilitate implementation of such provisions; directs OTDA and OMH to establish an oversight committee for such provisions; directs an annual report to be submitted by OTDA and OMH; directs OMH and OTDA to conduct a review of the effectiveness of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid reimbursement rates for inpatient psychiatric care
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid reimbursement rates for inpatient psychiatric care to remain consistent and uniform throughout the duration of the patient's hospitalization, regardless of length of stay.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state liquor authority to issue licenses to new premises for the sale of liquor where such premises is within two hundred feet of a place of worship, or where three or more such premises exist
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state liquor authority to issue licenses to new premises for the sale of liquor where such premises is located within two hundred feet of a place of worship and such place of worship has given approval, or where three or more such premises exist in counties of a certain population.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "help parents find and afford child care act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "help parents find and afford child care act"; provides for child care subsidies to be administered under the child care assistance program; establishes a tri-share child care program; establishes an at-home infant care program; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "home repair act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "home repair act" establishing a home repair program and home repair fund to assist in home repairs by homeowners and landlords to improve home conditions.

sponsored.t: Makes technical changes relating to the rescindment of certificates of authority
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes relating to the rescindment of certificates of authority clarifying that a failure to file a report or return relates only to the person's obligation to pay taxes.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state infrastructure bank
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state infrastructure bank to monitor and oversee infrastructure projects in the state, and to award financial assistance for such projects in the form of bonds.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all new residential and commercial construction that has dedicated off-street parking to implement electric vehicle supply equipment infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Requires all new residential and commercial construction that has dedicated off-street parking to implement electric vehicle supply equipment infrastructure in conformance with the requirements of the current edition of the national electrical code.

sponsored.t: Exempts a portion of poll workers' income earned on an election day from state income tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts a portion of poll workers' income earned on an election day from state income tax; requires the board of elections, in conjunction with the department of taxation and finance, to conduct a public awareness campaign to inform poll workers of such tax exemption; requires the department of taxation and finance to issue guidelines on how poll worker income should be reported on tax returns.

sponsored.t: Enacts the fair housing and source of income discrimination awareness act
sponsored.sum: Requires section 8 voucher holders to be provided notice of their legal protections from source of income discrimination; requires online housing platforms operating in the state to display notices of rights against source of income discrimination; makes related provisions; provides for penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes holders of certain licenses issued by the state liquor authority to engage in the sale or wholesale of ready-to-drink cocktails, and corrects certain provisions regarding sale of mead and cider
sponsored.sum: Authorizes holders of certain licenses issued by the state liquor authority to engage in the sale or wholesale of ready-to-drink cocktails; corrects certain provisions regarding sale of mead and cider.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of the term prospective relative guardian
sponsored.sum: Provides that no person shall be precluded from being deemed a "prospective relative guardian" based on whether such person's relationship with the child was established before or after such child's placement into foster care.

sponsored.t: Enacts the public benefits privacy act
sponsored.sum: Provides privacy protections for public benefits recipients regarding disclosure or inquiry about immigration status and eligibility; provides penalties for employees of state or local agencies that knowingly violate such provisions; directs OTDA to promulgate rules and regulations and submit an annual report regarding compliance with, and complaints regarding, violations of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibiting or limiting certain tax exemptions for real property in instances where a pattern or practice of discrimination against occupants has been found
sponsored.sum: Prohibits or limits certain tax exemptions for real property in instances where a pattern or practice of discrimination against occupants has been found based on such occupants' lawful source of income.

sponsored.t: Requires institutions and local correctional facilities to adhere to certain surveillance, recording and investigation standards
sponsored.sum: Requires institutions and local correctional facilities to adhere to certain standards regarding the surveillance of incarcerated individuals and detainees, and access to such surveillance recordings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of residential properties limited liability companies can own
sponsored.sum: Relates to the number of residential properties limited liability companies can own; requires beneficial owners of limited liability companies identify themselves when transferring or purchasing real property.

sponsored.t: Declares any conveyances of real property to a landlord identified on the city of New York's office of the public advocate's worst landlord watchlist as void as against public policy
sponsored.sum: Declares any conveyances of real property to a landlord identified on the city of New York's office of the public advocate's worst landlord watchlist as void as against public policy; provides for a $50,000 civil penalty for violations of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to notify tenants if common areas or amenities in their building will be out of service for more than seven consecutive days
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to notify tenants if common areas or amenities in their building will be out of service for more than seven consecutive days; provides for a $1,000 civil penalty for violation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the fair share for homeless shelters act
sponsored.sum: Establishes an office of fair share enforcement to oversee compliance with fair share mandates for siting of homeless shelters; provides for fair distribution of homeless shelters across municipalities and community districts to best serve the homeless population; requires reporting; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on retrofitting certain schools
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study on retrofitting certain schools located within 500 feet of a major highway.

sponsored.t: Provides remedies for tenants of illegal dwelling units who were forced to vacate due to an emergency vacate order or eviction
sponsored.sum: Requires a rebate of all rent paid to a landlord to be paid back to a tenant who was forced to vacate an illegal dwelling unit pursuant to an emergency vacate order or eviction.

sponsored.t: Eliminates late fees for residential utility customers
sponsored.sum: Eliminates late fees for residential utility customers; provides that no late payment charges may be imposed on residential customers.

sponsored.t: Relates to rights of persons with disabilities to be accompanied by a guide dog or service dog
sponsored.sum: Protects the rights of persons with disabilities to be accompanied by a guide dog or service dog in a place of public accommodation or housing accommodation; imposes a misdemeanor penalty for violations; requires the division of human rights to conduct a public awareness and education campaign.

sponsored.t: Requires third-party verification of an application to receive the Empire State film production credit and the Empire State film post production credit
sponsored.sum: Requires third-party verification of an application to receive the Empire State film production credit and the Empire State film post production credit by approved certified public accountants.

sponsored.t: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to liquidator's permits and temporary retail permits
sponsored.sum: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to liquidator's permits and temporary retail permits.

sponsored.t: Provides for program eligibility for plans comparable to Medicare part D
sponsored.sum: Relates to program eligibility for plans comparable to Medicare part D; provides for analysis of health plans by the department of health to determine whether such health plans meet or exceed the Medicare part D standard; requires the department of health, in consultation with the department of financial services, to notify prescription drug insurers of the provisions of this act.

sponsored.t: Relates to education transportation contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to employment contracts between school bus workers and the department of education in a city with at least one million inhabitants.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to rename the Burnside subway station the Burnside Bronx Community College subway station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to rename the Burnside subway station the Burnside-Bronx Community College subway station.

sponsored.t: Relates to wage parity compensation for home care workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to wage parity compensation for home care workers and establishes certain requirements for supplemental benefit decisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Medicaid reimbursement for mental health clubhouses
sponsored.sum: Defines "mental health clubhouse"; provides that the department of health, in consultation with the office of mental health, shall authorize Medicaid reimbursement for services provided by mental health clubhouses.

sponsored.t: Increases transparency of source of income discrimination findings and rental application outcomes for voucher holders
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of human rights to report on its website findings of discriminatory practices relating to lawful sources of income; requires landlords of 6 or more residential units to report annually certain information relating to applicants who receive rental subsidies.

sponsored.t: Requires additional reporting and documentation requirements for manifestation determination reviews
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to collect and annually report to the department of education certain information regarding manifestation determination reviews (MDRs) conducted during the prior school year; requires certain disaggregated information to be publicly reported regarding MDRs.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "child care for caregivers act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the regulated child care workforce as a priority population for child care assistance program funds; requires a public education and outreach campaign.

sponsored.t: Allows individuals to register in the donate life registry through mandatory personal income tax electronic tax filings
sponsored.sum: Allows individuals to register in the "donate life registry" on any mandatory electronic personal income tax filing.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 43 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7011-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to allowing individuals to register in the "donate life registry" through mandatory electronic personal income tax filings" NOT APPROVED This bill would include mandatory electronic personal income tax filings as an approved method by which individuals could register as an organ, eye, and/or tissue donor. I support the goal of this bill, which is to expand opportunities for New Yorkers to register to become organ, eye, and/or tissue donors through New York's Organ Donor Registry. Previously, New York had one of the lowest organ donor registry enrollment rates in the county, leaving thousands of New Yorker's waiting for a life-changing transplant. Last year, however, I announced that more than…

sponsored.t: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive
sponsored.sum: Permits an eligible retirement system member to receive, in lieu of an ordinary death benefit, a death benefit such member would otherwise be entitled to receive provided such member is a state-paid judge or justice of the unified court system or a housing judge of the civil court of the city of New York.
